wholePhysicalScope: The mapped common south wall and north-side step constrain the 25.9 m connected envelope. The deeper eastern volume is the two-storey engine house. The western volume is the single-storey boiler wing.
lodDetails: The shelter footprint, rail-facing opening, shed roof, nameboard, bench and platform remain present at all levels. Close views add bench slats, sign lettering and fasteners.
limitations: Wall and roof heights, window spacing and the connecting wall are approximate. The municipal illustration gives overall massing. The written heritage survey supplies opening and material details.
The current terrain remains unchanged. The DEM-derived approach and foundations give approximate vertical fit. The height of the now-demolished chimney is part of the historical record.
